answer_1.quote: We use IBIS to analyze the importance of word order in English text... We also explore constrained generation tasks such as generating text with lexical constraints, fixing start or end spans, and producing poetry.
answer_1.outputs: Reordered sentences, generated constrained texts, paraphrased versions of original sentences

answer_2.quote: BLEU scores of reconstructed sentences with respect to the original orders... Perplexity and token accuracy of GPT-2... accuracy on GLUE tasks ...

answer_4.quote: Three human subjects were asked to rate the relationship of IBIS-inferred punctuationless sentences to the original texts... annotators ranked each pair on a scale of 0 (unreadable) to 3 (identical).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each pair of sentences on a 0‑3 scale based on similarity of meaning and readability.
